0022600095.text: The Indiana Pacers (1-0, second in the Central, seventh in the East) host the Dallas Mavericks (0-1, fifth in the Southwest and one game back, 11th in the West) in the Pacers' second game of the season. Indiana is without Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and Ben Sheppard (knee soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Jett Howard (calf soreness) also a day-to-day game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 134-130 in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
